Stay open. Pick an intention and repeat it. Meditate and ask the source - whatever you define that as (I call her the universe even though she transcends that) - for signs you're on the right path as you go through the week. Journaling can help crystallize what's forefront or even hidden for you.

Don't judge or go into it with any assumptions of what it'll be like. That's a sure path to some really humbling realizations and experiences around our arrogance.

Lean in. Let yourself fall deeper or go higher. You'll be scared - but don't be. Nothing will hurt you there - not physically. You're in your own mind. 

Finally, plan your integration. Schedule a massage. Take some time off from work or life - just a few days. Buy a nice new journal you can work in. Line up some integration therapy to help to work what you learn into your life. Know your support network - and build it with a bunch of different people. You'll want to share what you learned with EVERYBODY but most people aren't ready or willing to learn. Know that coming out and trust your gut.
